author: 1337isnot1337, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: Adding a fixed scalar zero mode preserves the operator crossing and both directional partition-space envelopes. Its first moment has an explicit pairing q h! D P L D^-1, with L P=0. On the full weight-h label space, h>=2, this pairing is square-zero and for nonzero charge has exact rank p(h)-p(h-1). A common principal label pairing is nilpotent by partition length, so naive inversion fails. Written all-size arguments and bounded exact checks are supplied; alpha and the full asymptotic envelope are unchanged.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the charged normal-ordering and exact pairing/rank arguments
Uniform usable coordinates, integer recovery denominators and bit heights on a nondegenerate asymmetric label subspace
A change reducing the dominant crossing ratio, rather than only removing one shift
No complete SAT algorithm, larger alpha, or selected-result change is claimed
